name: Validate WO to Syock Entry
script:
if doc.purpose == "Manufacture" and doc.work_order and not doc.custom_bypass_validation:
    work_order = frappe.get_doc("Work Order", doc.work_order)
    bom = frappe.get_doc("BOM", work_order.bom_no)
    raw_item = {}
    
    for b_itm in bom.items:
        raw_item[b_itm.item_code] = (b_itm.qty / bom.quantity)
        
    fg = doc.get('items', {'is_finished_item': 1})
    fg_qty = fg[0].qty if fg else 0

    for itm in doc.get('items', {'is_finished_item': 0}):
        if itm.item_code in raw_item:
            qty = raw_item[itm.item_code] * fg_qty
            itm.qty = qty or 0
        
    rw = {itm.item_code for itm in doc.get('items', {'is_finished_item': 0})}
    missing_items = set(raw_item.keys()) - rw

    for item_code in missing_items:
        doc.append('items', {
            's_warehouse': work_order.wip_warehouse,
            'item_code': item_code,
            'qty': raw_item[item_code] * fg_qty,
            'item_name': frappe.db.get_value('Item', item_code, 'item_name'),
            'uom': frappe.db.get_value('Item', item_code, 'stock_uom'),
            'transfer_qty': raw_item[item_code] * fg_qty,
            'stock_uom': frappe.db.get_value('Item', item_code, 'stock_uom'),
            'conversion_factor': 1,
            'is_finished_item': 0
        })

name: Sales Invoice Minimum Order Quantity Validation
script:
customer_group = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.customer, "customer_group")

moq_list = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT moq.name
    FROM `tabMinimum Order Quantity` AS moq
    LEFT JOIN `tabMOQ Customer` AS moq_customer ON moq.name = moq_customer.parent
    WHERE moq.customer_group = %s
    AND (moq_customer.customer = %s OR moq_customer.customer IS NULL)
""", (customer_group, doc.customer), as_dict=True)

for m in moq_list:
    mo_doc = frappe.get_doc("Minimum Order Quantity", m['name'])
    moq_details = {(detail.item, detail.uom): detail for detail in mo_doc.moq_details}

    for item in doc.items:
        key = (item.item_code, item.uom)
        if key in moq_details:
            mo = moq_details[key]
            if mo.qty > item.qty:
                frappe.throw(f"The {item.item_code} Item Must Have Greater Qty Than {mo.qty} With UOM of {item.uom}")
